title: Every Attempt Recorded
description: Push one invoice through five payment attempts — a mix of declines, timeouts, and a final success — and prove the on-screen history is a faithful, gap-free ledger of everything that happened, matching the API's own record exactly.
successCondition: Submitting five payment attempts in sequence on one invoice (any mix of the two known-failing card numbers and ordinary numbers, ending in a successful one) results in the rendered attempt list containing exactly five lines, each with the correct attemptNumber (1 through 5, in order), each failed/timed-out line showing its failureReason and each successful line showing none, and the full rendered list is diffed against a direct GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments call to confirm no attempt is missing, duplicated, or reordered in the UI.
hints: Stop attempting once the invoice is paid — a well-formed card number should always succeed on the first try after the invoice is already open, so plan your sequence so the success is genuinely last.
Fetch the API's payment list once at the end and use it as your source of truth to diff the rendered DOM against, rather than hand-tracking five outcomes yourself.
